summary: I read the whole diff and checked it against BRIEF.md, docs/design/ and docs/decisions.md, and I ran git status and git diff. The change adds docs/design/requirements-map.md. It has a 45-row table with a status, an owning design and serving work for each requirement. It covers G, O1-O5, A1-A13, S1-S7, D1-D3, every one of the 11 addenda, and the sections the doc names ENV, STD, BND, ORD and JDG. The five status values are defined, and every cited design file exists. The doc specifies the A1 strategy view: typed records are the source of truth, the view is rendered on demand, and its header shows how stale it is. It has a roadmap that gives a reason for each dependency and lists the work not yet scheduled, plus a table of alternatives. The 10-job staleness threshold and the job counts are labeled as estimates, and update rules that nothing enforces are marked prose-only. The brief line numbers I spot-checked match BRIEF.md (154-159, 414, 80, 57, 395-396, 16-18, 121, and the addenda at 445-496). The cited decisions (D02, D26, D31, D34, D35, D58, D64, D69, D72, D75, D78) exist with matching subjects. Only Markdown files changed: CHANGELOG.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/decisions.md and the new doc. I found two minor gaps: the Settings section has no row, and the proposed policy test's rule of 'every ### heading' does not match the rows the map takes from ## sections.
